Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Enum Class PluginService

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PluginService>
dev.turboism.sdk.plugin.PluginService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PluginService>, Constable
public enum PluginService extends Enum<PluginService>
One optional service slot on PluginContext.

Members name the service interface they describe, so context.services().find(PluginStorage.class).isPresent() tells the plugin that a usable PluginStorage is installed. Guaranteed core members of PluginContext (descriptor, logger, paths, cubism, permissions, eventBus, actions, menus, uiScheduler, diagnostics, disposableScope) have no member because they cannot be absent.

Presence means the directory returns a usable service object; it does not imply the plugin holds the permissions that service's operations require, and it does not guarantee individual version-routed members succeed on the active host.

The catalog itself is stable, while a member's service type keeps its own maturity: members whose constant carries Incubating resolve to incubating service types and may still change between framework versions.
